'''Yog Armor'''{{'}}s {{AN|Absorb}} full set bonus grants the player {{Stat|ms|+1}} for every {{Green|5}} {{MobSprite|Yog}}s killed in the [[Bestiary]], up to {{Stat|ms|+500}} at {{Green|2,500}} {{MobSprite|Yog}}s killed.

== Skins ==
{{Item Skins|Yog Helmet}}

== Trivia ==
* '''Yog Armor''' is referred to as '''Armor of Yog''' in the [[Museum]].
* The {{AN|Absorb}} full set bonus used to be stored on the '''Yog Chestplate''' This meant that if a '''Yog Chestplate''' was traded or auctioned, the bonus would transfer over.
* '''Yog Armor''' and {{Item|Sorrow Armor}} are the only armor sets that have Universal Gemstone Slots.
*'''Yog Armor''', {{Item|Sorrow Armor}} and {{Item|Armor of Divan}} are the only armor sets that can store {{Item|Topaz}} Gemstones.
*Maxed '''Yog Armor''' grants {{Stat|ms|+1420}}, which is {{Stat|ms|60}} more than maxed {{Item|Armor of Divan}}.
* Placing a {{Item|Ruby}} in {{Item|Flamebreaker Armor}} and upgrading it into '''Yog Armor''' will cause the {{Item|Ruby}} to stop granting {{Stat|hp}}. It will be available for refund at the {{Item|Gemstone Grinder}}: additionally, the following text will display in the tooltip.
{{Dialogue|&cThis item has unused Gemstones! Visit Geo to remove them!}}
